name: Drakefire Amulet
label: Quest
description: Drakefire Amulet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.

It is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian. Perhaps you have heard of him?
Return with his blood, traveler, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to Onyxia's lair.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The flow of time does not stop or slow, traveler. While my life is eternal, yours is not. Waste not the time that you have...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of Onyxia can be found in Dustwallow Marsh. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.
The Blue Flight wishes you luck, friend.
